When Is Bhai Dooj 2026? Date, Muhurat, Significance, And Wishes
Bhai Dooj 2026 celebrates the eternal bond of siblings with the tilak ceremony, blessings, gifts and family feasts, honouring love, protection and togetherness across India.
Share Your Feedback
 Choose News18 on Google
Bhai Dooj- also known as Bhaiya Dooj in North India, Bhau Beej in Maharashtra and Bhai Phonta in Bengal- is a famous occasion that marks the conclusion of the five-day Diwali festival and celebrates the love between brothers and sisters. This ancient Hindu festival is dedicated to the eternal bond between brothers and sisters, and it also marks the significance of sibling love.
On this occasion, sisters apply tika or tilak on their brother’s forehead and bless them with ceremonial items and various gifts. While sisters pray for their brothers’ good health and long life, brothers promise to protect and support them on Bhai Dooj. The auspicious timings for the Tilak ceremony are known to be during the Aparahna or afternoon period, for two hours and fifteen minutes.

As per the Panchang, Bhai Dooj is celebrated on the Shukla Paksha Dwitiya Tithi of the month of Kartika.
In this article, we take a look at some key aspects of Bhai Dooj.
Bhai Dooj 2026 Date, Muhurat
According to Drik Panchang, Bhai Dooj will be celebrated this year on Wednesday, November 11.
- As per Drik Panchang, Bhai Dooj Aparahna time is from 01:10 PM to 03:20 PM.
- While Dwitiya Tithi will begin at 02:00 PM on November 10, it will end at 03:53 PM the next day.
Bhai Dooj 2026: Significance
Bhai Dooj signifies the deep bond between brothers and sisters. It serves as a reminder of the importance of sibling love, care and responsibility. At the same time, apart from sibling love, this occasion also fosters unity, care and togetherness in families. It is believed that this auspicious ceremony brings blessings, joyfulness and prosperity to both brother and sister.
Bhai Dooj 2026: Mythology
As per Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna paid a visit to his sister Subhadra after killing the demon Narkasur. She welcomed him wholeheartedly with flowers and sweets. She also applied a tilak on Lord Krishna’s forehead and prayed for his well-being.

Bhai Dooj 2026: FAQs
Why do we celebrate Bhai Dooj?
Bhai Dooj celebrates the siblings’ bond. On the occasion, the sister applies tilak on her brother’s forehead and prays for his well-being.
When is Bhai Dooj in 2026?
Bhai Dooj will be celebrated on November 11, this year.
